en.html:
The correct path.
The wrong path.

If my chosen path had been wrong, and even now I could choose the right one, I very much wanted to do that.

But... which had been right? Which had been wrong?

Looking back, everything seemed wrong. Yet had each decision not already been fixed, with no choice left to me—fixed by the mistake before it?

Then where was the root?
How far back did I have to go before starting again was even possible?

ja.html:
正しい道。
　誤った道。

　俺の選んだ道が誤りで。
　今からでも正しい道を選び直せるというなら、是非
そうしたい。

　だが。
　……何が正しく、何が誤っていたのだろう。

　振り返れば、何もかも誤りだったと思える。
　しかしその一つ一つは、既に選ぶ余地なく決定付け
られていたのではないか――それ以前の誤りによって。

　なら、根源はどこだ。
　どこまで遡れば、俺はやり直しが利くのだ？

en.html:
God.

God would bring peace?

...God?

Did that mean THAT God?

Had that thing been the final savior from some ancient prophecy or other, appearing to save the earth?

Everything in the world put right. My murders made never to have happened. Everyone's happiness returned?

Then what did that make me?

Was destroying it my greatest mistake?

What had I done?

Then... then...

en.html:
I flung God aside along with the anger surging up inside me. With a shriek, the thing ran off at full speed.

...Nothing could be done.
God was already dead.

No conveniently available being existed to cancel all my mistakes.

Nothing could be done.

Not about anything. Not anymore.

存在は何処にもいない。

　どうにもならない。

　もはや何もかも、どうにもならないのだ。
